from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/home/user/copy_sheet_insert.xlsx')
wb = load_workbook(path)
# Rename original Sheet1 first.
if 'Sheet1' in wb.sheetnames:
    wb['Sheet1'].title = 'LARS Resources'
elif 'Sheet 1' in wb.sheetnames:
    wb['Sheet 1'].title = 'LARS Resources'
else:
    raise SystemExit(f'Expected Sheet1/Sheet 1, found {wb.sheetnames}')

src = wb['LARS Resources']
backup_name = 'LARS Resources (Backup)'
if backup_name in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb[backup_name]
backup = wb.copy_worksheet(src)
backup.title = backup_name
# Place backup before Sheet2 (after original LARS Resources in this workbook).
idx_sheet2 = wb.sheetnames.index('Sheet2') if 'Sheet2' in wb.sheetnames else wb.sheetnames.index('LARS Resources (Offline)')
wb._sheets.remove(backup)
wb._sheets.insert(idx_sheet2, backup)

if 'Sheet2' in wb.sheetnames:
    wb['Sheet2'].title = 'LARS Resources (Offline)'
elif 'Sheet 2' in wb.sheetnames:
    wb['Sheet 2'].title = 'LARS Resources (Offline)'

wb.save(path)
print(wb.sheetnames)
PY"
